tagline: Store and serve OCI container images.
description:
Distribution Registry is the open source OCI/Docker registry implementation used to store, manage, and serve container images and other OCI artifacts.

This package runs the upstream registry image as a lightweight single-service HTTP API on port 5000. Image layers and manifests are persisted under the app data directory.

tips.before_install:
This app exposes a registry API, not a graphical Web UI. The health endpoint is available at /v2/.

The default configuration has no authentication and no TLS. Do not expose this port to untrusted networks without adding a reverse proxy, TLS, and access control.

author: IceWhaleTech
title: Distribution Registry
release_note: Switch to distribution/registry v2.7.0, the classic OCI registry stable line.
